one_liner: An all-in-one marketing, sales, and CRM platform with a robust public API.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant or private integration tokens (PIT) are supported.
access_notes: Developers can sign up on the Developer's Marketplace to get credentials.
api_notes: Covers v2 Public API endpoints including SaaS configurations, sub-accounts, and agency workflows.
blocker_notes: Public documentation, SDKs, and self-serve developer portal are available.

auth.quote: In the Developer's Marketplace, developers obtain an Access Token through the OAuth process, which allows their app to make authenticated API requests to GoHighLevel.

access.quote: Developers register their applications on the Developer's Marketplace, providing necessary details and defining scopes. They receive a Client ID and a Client Secret, unique identifiers for their application.

api.quote: HighLevel’s officially supported gohighlevel/api-client (PHP) and gohighlevel-api-client (Python) libraries wrap the entire v2 Public API.
